c74object.name: el.counter~
c74object.description:
el.counter~ is an audio-rate counter triggered by non-zero audio samples. Whenever a non-zero sample (such as a click or impulse) arrives at the input, the object outputs the current count value as a single-sample impulse and steps the counter. At all other times between triggers, the output remains 0. The counter loops continuously between specified minimum and maximum bounds in either an upward or downward direction.
Inlets
Inlet 1 (signal / messages): Non-zero trigger input and message inlet. Any non-zero audio sample triggers and increments the count. Also receives control messages (direction, minmax, setnext).
Outlets
Outlet 1 (signal): Counter impulse output. Emits a single-sample impulse equal to the current count value on trigger samples, and 0.0 at all other times.

inlet.description: Non-zero audio samples advance the count. Also accepts configuration messages.

outlet.description: Outputs an impulse with an amplitude equal to the current count index when triggered, and 0.0 otherwise.

objarg.name: minimum
objarg.description: The lower bound of the count range (default: 1). Must be 1 or greater.

objarg.name: maximum
objarg.description: The upper bound of the count range (default: 10). Must be greater than the minimum.

method.name: direction
method.description: Sets the counting direction: 1 counts upward (default), and -1 counts downward.

method.name: minmax
method.description: Sets the minimum and maximum counter bounds. The minimum must be at least 1 and less than the maximum.

method.name: setnext
method.description: Sets the value that will be output upon receiving the next trigger click. The value must fall within the current min and max range.

method.name: signal
method.description: Whenever an incoming sample is non-zero, the current count is output and the counter steps by the active direction.
